title: Participation-stage to PPR value test
primary_hypothesis: For QB, adding leakage-safe Phase 2 participation-stage outputs improves weekly PPR prediction accuracy beyond the existing rolling-usage feature set.
secondary_hypothesis: For RB, the participation-stage output may be redundant with existing rolling usage features; the full-replace arm is exploratory and non-gating.
margin_basis: fixed preregistered practical threshold; season-to-season noise is also reported rather than used to change the threshold post hoc

decision_rule.primary_gate: promote only if QB candidate MAE improvement versus baseline is at least 0.15 PPR points and the paired 95% bootstrap CI for candidate-minus-baseline excludes zero on the improvement side
decision_rule.rb_gate: variant E is exploratory; report whether full replacement is non-inferior but it cannot promote a model if QB fails
decision_rule.season_consistency: report every walk-forward season; no aggregate-only promotion
decision_rule.phase7_serving: untouched unless the preregistered primary QB gate passes

variants.A_baseline: current PPR model and causal feature set unchanged
variants.D_unconditional_expected_snap_share: baseline plus Phase 2 expected_snap_share = P(participation) * E(snap share | participation)
variants.E_rb_full_replace: RB only: remove preregistered rolling snap/rush-share/target-share usage features and add expected_snap_share

leakage.participation_source: existing Phase 2 hist_gbm OOF predictions only
leakage.rule: phase2_train_max_season must be strictly less than the PPR test season; no current-week snap or PPR label may enter any feature
leakage.matched_population: identical player-week keys for all arms within every position-season fold

evaluation.folds: walk-forward by test season using Phase 7 FINAL_CONFIG windows and the existing run_fold feature pipeline
evaluation.seasons: all seasons present in Phase 2 hist_gbm OOF, subject to a complete fold report
evaluation.sparse_history_definition: fewer than 3 prior player-week rows in the PPR training window; report separately from established players
evaluation.feature_importance: built-in fitted-model importance, with added participation features compared against incumbent usage features
